title: The Dining Plan Month: Plan Fee, Credit Grant, Expiry and Rollover
content:
On the first day of each active month of a Dining Plan, the plan's monthly plan fee is charged in advance and the plan's monthly meal credits are granted. The meal credits on a plan are a running count: the monthly grant, rollover credits and restored credits add to it, and meals redeemed and credits expiring take from it.

## The rule of the month

1. **First day of the month.** The plan's monthly plan fee is charged in advance and the plan's monthly meal credits are granted.
2. **Month end.** The unused credits at month end - the credits available on the plan at the end of the last day of the month, before any month-end expiry - expire as one month-end expiry. The plan's rollover percentage of those unused credits, rounded down to whole credits, but not more than the plan's rollover cap, is granted back as rollover credits on the first of the next month, after the old month's credits have expired. Rollover credits never roll a second time.
3. **Plan end.** When the plan ends, the remaining credits expire as one plan-end expiry.
4. **No money refund.** Where the plan does not refund unused credits in money - and no plan of the Dining Plan does - unused credits are never refunded in money.
5. **Live plans only.** Plan fees and credit grants, rollover grants included, may be posted only while the plan is in active or cancel pending status.

## The rollover quantity, defined

The rollover credits granted on the first of a month are: the rollover percentage applied to the previous month's unused credits at month end, the result rounded down to a whole number of credits, and that whole number limited to the rollover cap. All of the unused credits expire at month end; the rollover credits are a fresh grant on the first of the next month, not credits left standing.

## Posting by plan status

| Plan status | Plan fee and credit grants may be posted |
|---|---|
| Pending start | No |
| Active | Yes |
| Cancel pending | Yes |
| Ended | No |

## Worked months (hypothetical balances)

**Example A - Dining 30 Meal Plan** (rollover percentage 25 percent, cap 5 credits, monthly grant 30 credits). At the end of the last day of a month, 11.5 credits are unused, none of them rollover credits. The 11.5 credits expire as one month-end expiry. 25 percent of 11.5 is 2.875, rounded down to 2. Two is within the cap of 5, so 2 rollover credits are granted on the first of the next month, alongside that month's grant of 30 credits and the month's plan fee.

**Example B - Dining 60 Meal Plan** (rollover percentage 50 percent, cap 10 credits). 30 credits are unused at month end, none of them rollover credits. All 30 expire as one month-end expiry; 50 percent of 30 is 15, which is above the cap, so 10 rollover credits are granted on the first of the next month.

**Example C - plan end.** A plan ends with 6 credits remaining. The 6 credits expire as one plan-end expiry and nothing is paid back in money for them.
